source.note: Wave-1 row 15 named the Quaternius Animated Animals pig (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; Google Drive quota-blocked). This is Quaternius's pig from the reachable Farm Animal Pack on OpenGameArt, same author and style. Its .blend is used because the pack's Pig.fbx carries only Idle and Jump; the .blend has Idle, Walk, WalkSlow, Run, Jump and Death (no eating clip). Height 0.85 m is the top of the back at the hips, a full-grown farm pig.
